scope: Independent historical audit of intermediate candidate 87943a6: recomputation of preserved raw records and logs, archived frozen source/hash comparisons, no new evaluator/engine execution, build or timing. Working src/evaluation.cpp was concurrently edited for a later candidate, so source provenance is anchored to the 87943a6 Git blob and archived Linux manifest. Only this JSON report was written.

source_verification.linux_manifest_method: Compare each archived Linux raw source SHA256 with frozen Git LF bytes and with their CRLF checkout encoding. A match under either encoding establishes identical normalized source. The manifest uses 21 CRLF checkout files and two newly added LF v056 reference files. Working src/evaluation.cpp is ignored for historical provenance because a later candidate is in progress.
source_verification.provenance_limits: Declared source commits are not cryptographic proof of compilation. During this audit every recorded benchmark binary hash matched its on-disk executable, and all 23 archived Linux input hashes match frozen 87943a6 checkout bytes. The working src/evaluation.cpp changed as the next candidate began; current working-copy equivalence is explicitly out of scope. Profile JSON does not itself embed driver identity; the then-current driver hash is recorded here.

final_micro_profile.ratio_definition: Each block ratio is candidate ns/call divided by baseline ns/call, followed by median of nine block ratios. Less than one means lower candidate evaluator cost. It is not the ratio of the two independent medians.
final_micro_profile.timing_scope: Evaluator calls only; board construction, equivalence checks and IO are untimed. Equal call counts and order across variants. Current build script preserves separate translation units and disables LTO; no new timing/build run by auditor.

fixed_depth_search.ratio_definition: Wall speedup baseline/candidate is old elapsed time divided by new elapsed time; above one is faster new. Candidate/baseline time ratio below one is faster new. These orientations are reciprocal per pair; report medians are recomputed directly.
fixed_depth_search.timing_limits: Wall includes UCI play transaction and new-game reset; excludes process startup. Millisecond engine times can be zero or quantized. 10 selected positions at fixed depths, no equal-time match and no Elo estimation.

unique_unit_tests.skip_reason: Windows file symlink creation privilege unavailable

correctness.tool_counts_note: Dependent evaluation-state and external-baseline child suites counted once, as in tools-summary. GUI counters are separate rendered/integration checks, not added to native assertion counts.

desktop_boundary.limits: Boundary cumulative CPU only for matching known desktop engines; excludes replaced/exited processes. Aggregate monitor has separate sampling limitations.

load.desktop_boundary_limit: Zero matching desktop processes is a boundary observation, not continuous evidence that no desktop/search process existed during the run. It excludes exited/replaced processes. User-paused-game metadata does not prove an idle machine.

decision.decision: Rejected before deployment: exact scores but standalone evaluation slower

raw_profile_recomputed.ratio_definition: Each block ratio is candidate ns/call divided by baseline ns/call, followed by median of nine block ratios. Less than one means lower candidate evaluator cost. It is not the ratio of the two independent medians.
raw_profile_recomputed.timing_scope: Evaluator calls only; board construction, equivalence checks and IO are untimed. Equal call counts and order across variants. Current build script preserves separate translation units and disables LTO; no new timing/build run by auditor.

rejected_pilot.scope: Prior 32-byte table/shared-color-loop candidate was slower in the evaluator-only profile and was rejected before deployment. It is separate from the final compact 8-byte/color-loop implementation. Saved pilot binary hash is declared in decision metadata; current final executable is different.

conclusions.correctness: All 220 declared fixed-depth pairs match score, move, completed depth, nodes, seldepth, PV and TT counters with identical options. The frozen evaluation reference and preserved independent oracles also pass; this is extensive sampled evidence, not a formal proof for every legal position.
conclusions.evaluator_cost: Final candidate evaluator-only paired cost is about 6.35 percent lower with shield ON and 8.26 percent lower with shield OFF on the fixed 58-position corpus.
conclusions.whole_search_cost: Whole-search wall medians did not show an improvement. All six conditions have old/new speedup below one; default depths 3/4/5 are approximately 0.99079/0.99552/0.98365, corresponding to new wall-time medians about 0.93/0.45/1.66 percent higher. Other OFF-mode samples are also slightly slower. Noise and interference prevent a general performance claim.
conclusions.playing_strength: No strength gain, Elo change or win-rate gain was measured. Score/search equivalence is the intended effect of this optimization.
conclusions.host_load: Nonzero browser and other observed load existed. Sampling omits process transitions; residual includes unclassified benchmark children. Do not claim idle, CPU isolation, or exact external-interference percentages.
conclusions.failed_experiment: The rejected first pilot is retained and clearly separated; no sample or coefficient tuning is justified by these measurements.
conclusions.candidate_disposition: This is an archived intermediate result. Lower evaluator cost did not demonstrate whole-search speed improvement, so a subsequent candidate is being developed; this audit does not approve deployment.

candidate_disposition: Intermediate compact-table candidate; evaluator-only cost improved, but whole-search speed did not. Evidence retained; not a final deployment recommendation.

scope_transition_observations.explanation: Root explicitly redirected this audit to archived 87943a6 evidence while a third candidate began editing src/evaluation.cpp. These working-copy mismatches do not invalidate the earlier frozen benchmark records, and were not converted into equivalence claims.
